text: Take a slow breath in and let everything soften on the exhale.
Allow your shoulders to lower just a little.
Feel the weight of your body supported beneath you.
There is nothing you need to fix right now, just this breath and this moment.
As you breathe, imagine a gentle wave moving down your body, bringing you back to yourself.
Your mind becomes quieter, your body becomes steadier, your energy resets naturally.
Take one more slow, deep breath, and as you exhale, feel your entire system settle into
And you can move forward from this calm, centered place.
